image_kind: AI-generated scientific illustration; not an authentic micrograph or photograph
notes: Bilingual headings are from the app; anchored scientific labels have not been authored or reviewed. Individual images may be inaccurate. Prompt summaries are not verbatim generation-call records.

topics.known_review_issue: Verify historical microscope design and cork-cell wall representation against a subject reference.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One high-resolution, photorealistic scientific educational illustration for Class IX: a historically plausible seventeenth-century compound microscope beside a thin cork slice and a magnified honeycomb-like field of the empty rectangular cork cell walls that Robert Hooke observed. The cork chambers are dead cell walls, not living green cells. Continuous still-life composition, natural museum lighting, clean margins for software-added labels. No text, letters, numerals, arrows, logos, watermarks, grid or collage.

topics.known_review_issue: Verify plant and animal cell boundaries, organelles, and the distinctions on the rendered image.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One photorealistic educational scientific illustration of plant and animal cells in one coherent scene. Plant: cellulose wall outside plasma membrane, central vacuole, chloroplasts and nucleus. Animal: nucleus but no cell wall or chloroplasts. Anatomically plausible cutaway models, clear differentiable silhouettes, clean background and room for later labels. No generated text, arrows, logo or watermark.

topics.known_review_issue: Verify prokaryotic nucleoid, eukaryotic nucleus, envelopes and relative scale; illustration is conceptual.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One photorealistic scientific illustration with a small bacterial prokaryote and a larger eukaryotic cell in one continuous microscopic field. The bacterium has a nucleoid with DNA and no nuclear envelope; the eukaryote has a membrane-bound nucleus and membrane-bound organelles. Conceptual scale rather than a claimed measured micrograph. Space for added labels; no text, arrows or watermark.

topics.known_review_issue: Verify bilayer orientation and the actual placement of membrane proteins before anchoring labels.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One photorealistic scientific cutaway of a continuous plasma-membrane phospholipid bilayer: hydrophilic heads face watery exterior/interior and hydrophobic tails face inward; include plausible membrane proteins and a transmembrane channel. A few nearby small molecules without invented transport. Clear margins for added labels; no words, arrows or watermark.

topics.known_review_issue: Verify cell wall, plasma membrane and vacuole/tonoplast depiction.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One photorealistic plant-cell cutaway: cellulose cell wall outside the plasma membrane, a large central vacuole with tonoplast, nucleus and chloroplasts in peripheral cytoplasm. Realistic textbook visualization, clear space for later labels. No words, arrows, watermark or separated panels.

topics.known_review_issue: Verify interphase chromatin, nuclear pores and nucleolus depiction.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One photorealistic scientific interphase nucleus cutaway: double nuclear envelope with pores, diffuse uncondensed chromatin, nucleolus, and adjacent rough endoplasmic reticulum. Do not show condensed X-shaped chromosomes in an intact interphase nucleus. Conceptual visualization with space for later labels; no words or watermark.

topics.known_review_issue: Verify organelle membranes, cristae and thylakoid/grana structures.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One photorealistic scientific plant-cell illustration highlighting a cutaway mitochondrion with double membrane and cristae and a cutaway chloroplast with envelope and stacks of thylakoids. No claim of literal micrograph. Clear margins; no words, arrows, watermark or panels.

topics.known_review_issue: Verify rough/smooth ER, Golgi and lysosome identification; do not reuse vector-plate anchor coordinates.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One high-resolution realistic animal-cell cutaway showing rough ER adjacent to the nucleus and studded with ribosomes, smooth ER, a distinct Golgi cisternal stack and a few membrane-bound lysosomes and vesicles. Space for later labels. No generated words, arrows or watermark.

topics.known_review_issue: Mitosis and a separate meiosis draft are available; verify both and their coverage.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One high-resolution microscopy-inspired scientific illustration of one animal cell in mitotic metaphase, with duplicated chromosomes aligned at the metaphase plate and spindle fibers toward opposite poles. This depicts mitosis only; meiosis must be separately illustrated and reviewed. No text, arrows, sequential panels or watermark.

topics.known_review_issue: Protein synthesis and a biomolecules supplement are available; verify all required biomolecule classes and coverage.
topics.generation_prompt_summary: One high-resolution realistic molecular-scale scientific visualization of a ribosome with messenger RNA and an emerging polypeptide. This covers protein synthesis only, not all biomolecule classes. Do not present it as a literal optical micrograph. No generated text, arrows or watermark.
